title: npm client ignores engine mismatches
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that installs packages regardless of the runtime they declare. A package built for another Node version installs silently, so the build runs code on a runtime its publisher never tested.
remediation: Enable `engine-strict` and align the runtime with the declared range.
limitation: It matches a client setting that installs packages regardless of the runtime they declare in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
